dialog: Time to wipe away the filth... I'd say/ if I wanted to be mean.
I wouldn't want you to get bored.
You've heard of the idea of reciprocity" before/ of course?
To take and not give back... why/ that'd be inexcusable!
Well then/ allow me to return the favor!
You won't end things that easily.
Even I know how to do danmaku/ you know!
I must show my pride as a leader of the Lunar Emissaries.
I have to show my skills off to Lady Yagokoro!
Try this on for size.
You're completely open.
Goodbye now!
You won't be getting away from this.
This is a single strand of our treasured braided cords―
A bond of pratyaya that can never be severed...
Ever.
I'll use a femtofiber.
Try this on for size.
See/ they're quite strong/ aren't they?

Here!
This is what femto-scale can do!
The easiest way to explain femto-technology...
is by demonstration!
Basically/ it's like that.

Be purified.
... I suppose I should put this all back to how it was soon.
If this is what is fated to be...
If this is what is fated to be...
Then let it be done greatly and beautifully...
This purified landscape sticks out like a sore thumb/ though/ huh.
Weapons are to be used like this.
This is the power of Lunarian weaponry.
Should I even be using this? Oh well.
You just keep on being complacent/ okay?
Audacious/ aren't we?
I have a duty to exact revenge now.
Call for me and I'll come!
Leave tidying this up to me.

That's a no-no/ keep your eyes facing the enemy!
Let's change our positioning.
Let's join forces/ the two of us.
Please do this properly/ okay?
I assume it's fine for me to help you/ right?
I can get through your defenses even from here.
I'd like you to show me what you're capable of.
You can just keep staying back there all day/ if you want.
This is the essence of the surface's custom of danmaku.
Don't get me wrong/ I still don't want to get caught up in any of this.
And now/ I will link the mountains and seas.
Reisen/ what a spectacular maneuver that was!
Reisen/ I'll clean up the rest.
Reisen/ you can leave the rest to me.
I wouldn't mind if you stopped cowering.
It's proper to protect your pets.
Don't be sloppy this time/ Reisen!
Reisen/ I'll give you a little help.
I'll take the front/ Reisen.
You can manage this much/ right?

Lady Kaguya/ try to let yourself feel just a little in tune with the moon.

What did you do to Lady Yagokoro?! You...

Lady Yagokoro/ please allow me to deal with this.

Lady Yagokoro/ I will provide support!
Lady Yagokoro/ I will follow you into battle.

Yorihime/ you acted too rashly...
Yorihime/ search for your next opponent!
Yorihime/ you can leave the rest to me.
Yorihime/ let's change places.
Yorihime/ was that carelessness?

Yorihime/ I'll be watching you from behind.
Yorihime/ let's join forces.

How repulsive.
Would you please not touch me?
The circumstances are just horrible.
I just do not accept the way things are going.
... maybe you're trying to provoke me?
Aah/ ouch!
That was an excellent attack.\n I'll let that one slide.

You can bark/ but do you have any bite?
How repulsive.
There's all sorts of things I shouldn't say about that one!
Ooh/ close!
Oh/ that just didn't hit/ did it?
I wonder if you were aiming these.

Now I'm all filthy. It's a certain somebody's fault...
How repulsive.

Give it another go/ I'm sure next time will work.
Is that's what you're going with?
This desperation- it's SO Earthling of you.
You're wasting your time/ you know?
Out of the way.
Since we already know how this will turn out/ why don't we do this the quick way?
It's not hard for me to change our positions.
Aaagh/ and in front of Lady Yagokoro...
This was due to my own clumsiness...
That was some good exercise.\n Feel free to keep going without me!
That's enough for me/\n I think I'll go eat a peach or something.
Your insolence against Lady Yagokoro cannot be permitted!
I'll show you your proper place/ Earth youkai!
Even though they may resemble us in appearance/ they're truly nothing like us.
You may be nothing more than a fake/ but I still feel hesitant...
Lady Kaguya/ please forgive this impudence.
The true power of Lunarian weaponry cannot be duplicated/ you know?
I think I'd rather not have such a barbaric younger sister!
I'll have you to lead me straight to Makura.
This isn't a power you should be using in such an unsound way.
Oh/ you just don't know when to quit/ do you?

I'm sorry to say/ but your dream ends here.
